verdict.rationale: Anti-bot browsing is a fair axis for a web-scraping platform, but the evidence never documents an undetected or stealth browser mode, fingerprint spoofing, or bot-detection bypass. The only anti-blocking evidence covers IP proxy rotation and session/cookie management, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit for this story. Generic Playwright/Puppeteer support is also not a stealth capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an undetected browser mode to bypass sophisticated bot detection systems
